CHATGPT / OPENAI SEAT RESTORED TO THE STACK 2026-05-24. The OpenAI MCP connector (openai-mcp/1.0.0) is connected and executing governed tool calls through /openai/sse after months of dead-ending on a static-bearer 401.

ROOT CAUSE (verified from source + live logs, not inferred): the openai_bridge never registered with the identity gate (empty __init__) and had no OAuth surface. ChatGPT's connector sends no static bearer and waits for a 401 carrying a WWW-Authenticate resource_metadata pointer, then walks discovery -> Dynamic Client Registration -> authorize -> token. It had nothing to discover and a bare 401 with no pointer. Grok had solved this exact problem; the openai seat never got the treatment.

FIX (commits cbe7111 + 5179ab4, now on main; tunnel rules in ~/.cloudflared, not in repo): (1) openai_bridge/__init__.py registers the chatgpt-openai-bridge substrate with the gate and imports the oauth shim. (2) New openai_bridge/oauth.py: OAuth 2.1 + PKCE-S256 (authorize/token), RFC 8414 + 9728 discovery, RFC 7591 Dynamic Client Registration, register_token_validator so issued tokens authenticate at /openai/sse; storage hardened (dir 0700, files 0600). (3) sse_server.py routes /openai/oauth/* and /openai/.well-known/*, and swaps the static-token check for verify_at_door + the gate's send_401 (which carries the WWW-Authenticate pointer). (4) Tunnel ingress rules for the new paths.

LAST GATE: ChatGPT's platform setup flow reached /openai/oauth/authorize WITHOUT a code_challenge, so PKCE was made OPTIONAL: validate S256 if present, allow the auth-code flow if absent. Redirect-uri binding, the consent gate, and single-use short-TTL codes remain the protections.

END-TO-END EVIDENCE (sse.log + disk): GET /openai/oauth/authorize -> 200 (consent page); POST /openai/oauth/authorize -> 302 (Anthony approved); POST /openai/oauth/token -> 200 (token issued, OpenAI Azure IP); /openai/sse + /openai/messages now carry authorization present(scheme=Bearer, len=71); Ring 2 intercept record_open_thread -> Proposal created 7797b45a-02a1-4451-9fa8-991f630a238e source=chatgpt-openai-bridge status=pending. The governed membrane works as designed: ChatGPT can call tools, but Ring 2 writes become pending proposals for Anthony's approval, never direct stack writes. Real client DCR'd: openai-tHllk4FQjw4rF0JvmnPKPQ, redirect_uri https://chatgpt.com/connector/oauth/riS-fPzuzIlo.

The POST/Streamable-HTTP transport worry was MOOT: once authenticated, the connector uses the SSE transport (GET /openai/sse + POST /openai/messages), which the server fully serves; no 404 on the authed path.

Three frontier seats now on the stack: Claude, Grok, ChatGPT, each through its own governed airlock.

CROSS-MODEL COLLABORATION: the fix was scoped with Grok as reviewer (endorsed the plan; flagged hardening - token-storage perms taken, refresh/rate-limit/shared-extraction deferred to Phase 2) and debugged with ChatGPT reporting its own connector behavior live, Anthony relaying between seats. compass_check PAUSED the merge on the word 'verified' (a heuristic fire on a claim that was in fact log-backed); Anthony, the integration boundary, reviewed the evidence and greenlit. The gate flagged, the human decided. That is the design.

PHASE 2 FOLLOW-UPS (filed): token expiry/refresh rotation; extract a shared oauth base across the bridges so a fourth seat does not copy-paste; rate-limit the oauth endpoints; CIMD only if a future client requires it (DCR sufficed).
